text:
kate_sales: FYI, Prospect 'ClearLane' just reported intermittent 429s during their POC run. Happens when they kick off a scheduled bulk enrich job + realtime chat. Started ~09:02 local.

kate_sales: Client logs show: `HTTP 429` and header `X-RDX-Consumed: 12250/12500` then next minute `X-RDX-Consumed: 12500/12500`. They thought monthly quota would prevent this.

omar_se: Got it. Two questions: 1) what's their requested batch size / concurrency? 2) are they using streaming or non-streaming calls?

kate_sales: They run 10 parallel embed uploads, batch=256, plus 6 chat calls per second. SDK is rdx-node 0.8.4.

zara_engineer: Quick note — rdx-node 0.8.x didn't expose intermediate token costs for streaming; finalization could create a surprise billing spike. Recommend upgrade to >=0.9.0.

lee_support: Checking tenant snapshot: tier=poc burst_window_s=60 burst_tokens=12500 current_window_used=12380

quota_bot: [quota-alert] tenant=clearlane used=12380 limit=12500 window=60s burst_remaining=120

omar_se: So only ~120 tokens left in the 60s window. A single embed batch (256 items) can easily cost >120 tokens -> immediate 429. This is burst exhaustion behavior, independent of monthly commit.

kate_sales: Customer wants a quick fix so nightly job can finish. They don't want to change code mid-demo. Any short-lived infra option?

zara_engineer: We can apply a short reservation to this tenant's burst window (e.g., +5k tokens for 90 minutes). That will let the one-off complete. Require billing sign-off and audit log.

ops_audit: [audit-check] past overrides for poc tenants require approval and get tagged in deal notes.

lee_support: Also a client-side workaround: lower parallel workers to 3 and split batch to 64; slower but no infra change.

omar_se: For immediate resolution I'll provision a 90m burst override: id=burst-20260321-6543 apply: tenant.clearlane.burst_add=5000 ttl=5400. Need approval from sales.

kate_sales: Approve. Mark in deal notes and revert after.

ops_audit: [quota-change] applied tenant=clearlane by=omar_se id=burst-20260321-6543 added_tokens=5000 expires=1793462289

lee_support: Customer confirmed job completed after override. They still want guidance on preventing future surprises.

zara_engineer: Follow-ups to reduce recurrence: 1) surface aggregated remaining across routes in API header so clients can make deterministic decisions (header e.g., `X-RDX-Aggregate-Remaining`), 2) SDKs should warn when a single request's estimated tokens > current burst_remaining, 3) server-side opt-in auto-split for large embedding uploads.

omar_se: Also flag: we saw some requests with negative bucket_before in proxy logs, which means concurrent accounting raced. Need to add a small atomic check in proxy to avoid reporting remaining>0 to some requests and 0 to others at same instant. Filing INFRA ticket.

kate_sales: Can you paste the tiny log excerpt that shows the negative bucket? Customer wants a short explanation to include in the postmortem.

zara_engineer: Paste trimmed log (epoch ms):
```
[1793456882] tenant=clearlane route=/v1/embeddings tokens=420 bucket_before=160 bucket_after=-260 throttle=1 -> 429
[1793456883] tenant=clearlane route=/v1/chat tokens=40 bucket_before=-260 bucket_after=-300 throttle=1 -> 429
```

lee_support: Explanation for customer: "Burst tokens are enforced per short window to protect shared infra. Large concurrent requests can consume the window in milliseconds; even if your monthly balance is sufficient, the window limit still applies. We provided a short reservation to finish the job and recommend changing batch/concurrency for long-term stability."

kate_sales: Customer asked about billing for the override. Will they be charged?

ops_audit: Temporary presales overrides are recorded but not billed to the customer; tracked internally. Any production override >24h requires billing review.

omar_se: Next steps: 1) add a small one-pager to presales runbook with exact CLI snippets to split uploads (we'll share a sample CLI), 2) SDK teams to add preflight token estimate call, 3) infra to implement atomic accounting and aggregated header.

kate_sales: Please add runbook link to CRM and note that we did a temporary override. Also request engineering tickets be linked to the deal for transparency.

lee_support: I'll upload the runbook draft now (will send link in thread when done). For immediate customer action, here's a shell helper they can run to split files: 
```
# split file into chunks of 64 lines and upload with 0.5s gap
split -l 64 big-embeds.jsonl chunk_
for p in chunk_*; do rdx upload-embeds --file $p; sleep 0.5; done
```

kate_sales: Thanks everyone. Demo succeeded, moving deal forward. Please keep the audit record and attach runbook to the opportunity. :sparkles:
